name: Chambray Button-Down Midi Dress
description: A breezy chambray midi dress with a gathered bustline and front button-down detail. Perfect for brunch dates and sunny afternoon strolls. The relaxed A-line silhouette flatters every figure.

name: Olive Leaf Print Tiered Anarkali Set
description: A stunning olive-green tiered anarkali kurta adorned with white leaf prints, paired with printed cigarette pants. The V-neckline and flared silhouette create an effortlessly elegant look.

name: Purple Bandhani Anarkali Suit with Dupatta
description: A regal purple anarkali suit featuring intricate bandhani-inspired white dot work and mandala motifs. Complete with matching pants and a flowing dupatta for a head-turning festive look.

name: Maroon Embroidered Silk Kurta Set
description: A richly embroidered maroon silk kurta with intricate yoke detailing and matching slim-fit pants. The A-line cut and lustrous fabric make this ideal for celebrations and special occasions.

name: Red Mirror Work Crop Top & Palazzo Set
description: A bold red co-ord set featuring a crop top with delicate mirror work trim paired with high-waisted wide-leg palazzos. A perfect fusion of contemporary style and traditional craftsmanship.

name: Fuchsia Palm Print Co-ord Set
description: A vibrant fuchsia co-ord set with playful palm tree embroidery. The sleeveless collared top and wide-leg pants create a resort-ready look that's equal parts fun and sophisticated.
